theme: A quiet last day in Cavtat before the flight home.
greeting: Your final day in Croatia, Dan — the charter is behind you and Cavtat is yours until the early airport run. An easy evening tonight; tomorrow is the long haul back to Tampa.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for tomorrow's Tampa landing
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 Todoist task to book the Sept 20-Oct 5 full-size SUV at TPA still shows open. You land Tampa tomorrow at 3:55 PM on a Sunday, so booking now avoids jet-lagged walk-up rates.

needsAttention.title: St Pete lodging for the landing gap
needsAttention.detail: The nights of Sept 20-21 are still unbooked in Todoist. You arrive Tampa tomorrow afternoon and the kids' pickup is not until Tuesday, so you need somewhere for two nights first.

flagged.title: Venmo request from Joshua Weaver
flagged.detail: He has requested $50 for mowing (Sept 17), awaiting your response.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, travel receipts, and subscription renewals.

resolved.title: Airport transfer for the early flight
resolved.detail: Uber has confirmed a 5:35 AM pickup Sunday from the Remisens hotel for the 7:30 AM departure out of Dubrovnik.

recipe.title: Vin santo–roasted pears
recipe.why: Autumn pears are at their peak now, and a slow roast in sweet wine is the season's easiest luxury.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas rental (refundable full-size SUV, PWM)
Plan a grocery stop before the Orlando villa

acts.line: Off the charter and settled ashore in Cavtat after the sailing week.
A slow last afternoon on the Adriatic, nothing on the calendar to answer to.
An early night ahead of the 5:35 AM pickup and the Dubrovnik-Frankfurt-Tampa flights home.
